    elif tax_change < 0:

        s["Refunded"] += (
            -tax_change
        )

    s["TaxablePnL"] = (
        new_ytd
    )

    s["TheoreticalTax"] = (
        new_tax
    )

    FIX15_TAX_LEDGER.append({

        "TaxablePnL": taxable_pnl,
